note: A consumer of tj-actions/changed-files at the time of the March 2025 tag compromise (push.yml as it stood from April 2024 until after the incident): the publish-changes job resolves changed-files@v42 by tag, then publishes the npm packages through a local composite action holding NPM_TOKEN and a personal access token. The compromised tag ran with both secrets in reach. The publish step lives inside ./.github/actions/job-publish, which the workflow scan does not read, so no publishes impact is proven and the spec gives High (secrets, no impact) rather than Critical. The deploy job's own-organization deploy action, pinned by tag into an environment with AWS keys, is the Critical path of the file.
